categories_in_priority_order.eligibility: Person is a substantial foreground subject. Native image must visibly support assessing skin tone plus eye/nose/mouth boundaries and useful skin/shadow detail. Tiny background face or arm alone is ineligible; no age/ethnicity inference needed.
categories_in_priority_order.native_crop: Source-chosen face including eyes/nose/mouth and a skin-to-shadow transition, coordinates frozen before operator outputs.

categories_in_priority_order.eligibility: A built scene, architecture or interior with useful neutral materials and edges, OR clearly readable text/signage. Plate/tableware edges alone do not qualify. Text is optional when built-scene material and edges are adequate.
categories_in_priority_order.native_crop: Readable text if present, otherwise neutral material/structural edge plus nearby texture.

categories_in_priority_order.eligibility: Substantial chromatic natural foliage/flowers or objects with visible color and texture. Plated food is allowed for this slot; source saturation must leave meaningful distinctions to inspect.
categories_in_priority_order.native_crop: Color/texture transition selected solely from source.

categories_in_priority_order.eligibility: Indoor/outdoor environmental scene with substantial low-light or shadow structure AND useful highlights, with some retained source detail in those regions. A dark plate background or food-cast shadow alone is ineligible.
categories_in_priority_order.native_crop: Useful shadow texture and highlight boundary; source regions already featureless cannot establish new detail damage.

record.selection: Within each split, for each category in priority order select earliest ranked eligible component, skipping already reserved components; defer final commitment until relevant tranche classification and native confirmation. If native confirmation fails, record why and take next ranked source eligible for the same category. Do not view operator output while selecting. Keep all rejections/uncertainties.
